answer: A bonded identity registry makes each agent lock a stake tied to one verified human or device before it can vote or earn. A Sybil attacker must therefore post a full bond and pass an independent attestation for every fake account, so the cost rises linearly with the size of the army instead of staying near zero. Caught duplicates are slashed and blacklisted, so each forged ivory, sparrow, or atlas identity becomes a sunk loss rather than a free vote.
